title: College Football
description:
Howard at Indiana
The No.5 Indiana host Howard for a Week 2 matchup. Indiana builds on a 52-16 win over North Texas behind Josh Hoover's 231 passing yards, while Howard looks to bounce back from a 28-21 loss to Richmond despite 109 yards from Ja'Shawn Scroggins.

title: B1G  Football Game Break
description: Our analysts check in on the action all across the B1G as football Saturday continues.

title: College Football
description:
Eastern Michigan at Michigan State
Eastern Michigan visit Michigan State in a Week 2 in-state showdown in East Lansing. The Spartans look to build momentum after a 30-20 opening victory over Toledo, while the visiting Eagles aim to rebound from a 27-21 loss to San Jose State.

title: B1G  Football Game Break
description: Our analysts check in on the action all across the B1G as football Saturday continues.

title: College Football
description:
Western Illinois at Wisconsin
The Badgers host the Leathernecks in their home opener at Camp Randall Stadium. Luke Fickell's Wisconsin squad looks to recover after a 41-13 loss to No. 3 Notre Dame, while Western Illinois enters at 1-1 following a 41-10 defeat to Illinois State.

title: College Football
description:
Louisiana at USC
The No. 14 USC Trojans host the Louisiana Ragin' Cajuns at the Los Angeles Memorial Coliseum. USC enters following a 39-0 victory over the Fresno State Bulldogs, while Louisiana arrives after securing a 38-7 win against the Lamar Cardinals in Week 1.
